name: Ruou sim
summary: A wine made from forest sim fruit, sold on the island as myrtle wine. Pour a glass at Bãi Sao or after the forest walk.
origin: Phu Quoc. Bãi Sao, the park, and the Dinh Cau night market.
howToEat: Drink it at Bãi Sao or on the forest walk, or buy a bottle at the Dinh Cậu night market.
where: Bãi Sao, the national park, and the Dinh Cậu night market.
seoTitle: Ruou sim rung — forest sim wine on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Rượu sim rừng is Phu Quoc’s forest sim wine, also called myrtle wine, poured at Bãi Sao and in the national park.
